title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode2 A Night of Shooting Stars

meta.Episode: Episode2 — A Night of Shooting Stars
meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Aren't they...? Ichika and the girls...?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I think I saw something about it on TV this morning.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Really?
Does that mean we can see more if we wait here for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: A meteor shower... That must look amazing.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Just making a wish that we could stay like this forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Playing together, talking about stuff, watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish we could stay like this forever...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now I see... Everything started from here for them...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, why don't we try playing this song next?!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is that a new Miku song?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this one's sung by Luka.
It's really cool, and I thought you'd like it, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Really...? Then, I'll try listening to it a little.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
I wanna listen, too!
I can't wait to hear what it's like♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can tell that they all really enjoy playing together.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'd happily keep listening to this performance forever.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It seems like they can't hear my voice in this SEKAI, so since I'm here...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
So it's still unclear when you're going to be discharged.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but it's not all bad!
I can do my homework and stuff here, and you guys are always here to visit!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright...
We'll be back to visit soon.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Really soon.
So, Saki, please try to be patient...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me. I got you some snacks that everyone in our class has been talking about... I know you like this sort of thing.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Try them when you get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Oh, it's those milk tea flavored potato chips?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much! I've really been wanting to try these!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: I was a little startled at first, but they're actually pretty good...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they're sweet and salty in such a way that I had a hard time stopping myself.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I was told that it's okay for me to have some snacks, so I'll give them a try later♪

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I'll give you all my review the next time you come and visit!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Great. Okay, we'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Their footsteps are slowly fading to silence...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I know I'm in a fragment right now, so there's no way for Saki from this time to hear me... But...)
